first_cycle: Four academic routes: GCSE Foundation (AQA), GCSE Higher (AQA), IGCSE Extended (Cambridge), A Level AS (Cambridge).
Each academic route receives one original Daily skill check, one Weekly multi-step application and one Exam integrated reasoning draft.

The initial set of 12 original questions has been independently checked and published to the private Supabase bank; newer batches may be released after full mathematical and duplicate validations under owner's approval.
Persist original question source, four unique answer choices, one keyed correct response, clear worked rationale, common wrong-method cues, approximate timing and tier/level/board.
Question-bank multiple choice is currently one mark in the task marking system; full multi-mark rubric functionality needs separate authoring and assessment implementation.
Later cycles should address GCSE Higher/noncalculator, Cambridge IGCSE Core, Pearson IGCSE 4MA1, IB AA/AI SL/HL, Further Maths and TMUA without mixing incompatible syllabuses.

tier_guidance.daily: Single transferable micro-skill plus explanation of working; short, accessible and purposeful, 2–5 minutes
tier_guidance.weekly: At least two linked steps with an explicit modelling or reasoning decision and check, ~6–9 minutes
tier_guidance.exam: Integrated multi-step problem; include justification, suitable domain/restrictions and credible distractors; do not falsely label short practice as a full mock
